mapping_note: RL-422 records that the pinned Lab candidate is incorrectly labeled §10.57.6 and bound to evokeCallback. The candidate source is the §10.58 Evoke Multiple Callbacks service; this contract preserves the candidate ID but maps the tested behavior to canonical §10.58.
notes: This bounded HLA_EVOKED public-API witness queues 120 receive-order callbacks before invoking the service, then adds a 10 ms delay in the test recorder callback so the backlog remains active across a 150 ms minimum and 500 ms maximum window. It verifies that callbacks continue beyond the minimum and that the call does not return materially before the maximum or materially exceed it, with a 100 ms timing tolerance. The boolean pending-callback indicator is not asserted because whether another message is in flight at return depends on a transport race. This does not establish HLA_IMMEDIATE behavior, 1 ms argument precision, Java parity, independent-provider interoperability, or RTI conformance.
